Hi Lena — thanks for the quick note and sorry for the disruption.

Short answer: payment hold was triggered automatically by our nightly VAT revalidation job (run 2025-05-17) where your VAT number returned a failure in VIES during retrying. We run a conservative hold policy for EU B2B customers when the revalidation fails and the monthly invoice total exceeds €5,000 — that threshold is active for ARR accounts.

What we need to release the hold: a copy of a current VAT registration certificate (national certificate) or a screenshot of your VIES lookup showing the VAT number as valid, plus a brief confirmation that the billing entity is the same legal entity on the PO. If you can upload the certificate to the Drive link below or reply to this thread we’ll process it today.

Notes / context for your team: during yesterday’s run ~18% of revalidations failed due to intermittent VIES timeouts for DE/NL/BE ranges; we flagged any failed revalidations that also met the invoice threshold. We include a short CSV of the batch in case you want to review which invoices were impacted.

Upload link: https://drive.redwood.com/file/d/1a2b3vat-evidence
Batch report: attached (vat-batch-report-20250517.csv)

I’ll loop Marissa and Ben to confirm next steps on our side and to expedite any manual review.

Best,
Irene Choi
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Lena — Ben here from Revenue. Thanks for flagging. To move fast we can accept either:
1) a stamped VAT registration certificate (PDF) showing the VAT number and effective date, or
2) a screenshot of a live VIES lookup (include the lookup timestamp).

If you upload the certificate to the Drive link (or reply with the PDF) we’ll clear the hold and re-submit the invoice for collection within the same day. If you’re unable to provide the certificate immediately, confirm if you can initiate a one-time wire for the outstanding amount (we’ll mark the invoice as paid on receipt).

We understand VIES flakiness — we’ll also open a ticket with our compliance team to avoid noisy revalidations for accounts with stable payment history.
